why_no_r2: Enterprise coordinate/precision placement on P^1 is not currently generated canonically from the algebraic source and fails the presentation/automorphism gate.

Replacing that placement by intrinsic formal/jet or scheme-theoretic fiber data produces a genuine nontrivial enrichment, but it is established algebraic prior art and does not qualify as Enterprise-specific realization content.
The frozen Boolean-support BRC core is relationally derived and excludes the multiplicity/provenance carriers that could create a theorem-relevant same-readout distinction.
No H0 construction simultaneously passed non-factorization, presentation independence, automorphism/relabeling, functoriality, target-leakage, and Enterprise-specific-origin gates.
scope_statement: This is not a theorem that no Enterprise R2 realization can ever exist. It is a qualification result for the currently frozen Enterprise primitives and the H0 candidates actually audited.
